source.headline: Trump: Maybe I don't go full into Iran because of election

summary: Forex Factory surfaced a new Trump comment saying he may not go 'full into Iran' because of the election. The wording is tentative rather than a policy decision, but it is a modest de-escalation signal relative to the same-session backdrop of sharply higher oil, Treasury yields and prolonged-war concerns. The signal is therefore treated as low-conviction and subordinate to current macro conditions.

learning_profile.effect: kept immediate directional confidence at 3/10 because low-confidence directional 15m signals are an ACTIONABLE underperforming segment; the tentative de-escalation headline was not allowed to override the strongly inflationary/risk-off market context

predictions.mechanism: A tentative signal that the U.S. president may limit further Iran escalation marginally reduces geopolitical and oil-supply risk premium, which is supportive for broad equities; conviction is low because no policy change was announced and yields/oil remain extremely elevated.
predictions.invalidation: A renewed explicit escalation threat, fresh attacks on energy/shipping infrastructure, or another sharp rise in oil and Treasury yields would negate the modest positive impulse.

predictions.mechanism: Any reduction in geopolitical escalation risk can ease the oil/inflation tail risk weighing on long-duration technology shares, but near-5% US10Y yields sharply limit the expected upside response.
predictions.invalidation: A renewed rise in oil/yields or a clear reversal toward military escalation would invalidate the call.

predictions.mechanism: A modest de-escalation signal reduces safe-haven demand at the margin, while high US yields remain a headwind for gold; the tentative wording prevents a stronger bearish forecast.
predictions.invalidation: Fresh escalation, additional attacks, or a sharp fall in Treasury yields would invalidate the downside bias.
